verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line on the Iceberg tables docs page referencing "time travel for historical data access in BigQuery." That suggests querying data as of a past point, but it is a thin mention scoped to Iceberg managed tables. Nothing documents restoring dropped or corrupted tables. Missing for 10: documented point-in-time query syntax and retention window, restore/undelete of dropped tables, recovery of corrupted data from history, coverage for standard (non-Iceberg) tables, independent or hands-on corroboration.
